title: Measurement and Geometry - Lesson 7 Practice: Pyramid Volume Exploration
description: Practice comparing prisms and pyramids with the same base and height, then use V = (1/3)Bh.

questions.question: A rectangular prism and a rectangular pyramid have the same base area and height. How does the pyramid volume compare to the prism volume?
options: It is the same as the prism volume.
It is one-half of the prism volume.
It is one-third of the prism volume.
It is three times the prism volume.
questions.explanation: A pyramid with the same base and height as a prism has one-third of the matching prism's volume.

questions.question: Which formula gives the volume of a pyramid when B is the base area and h is the height?
questions.explanation: A pyramid's volume is one-third of the matching prism volume, so V = (1/3)Bh.

questions.question: A pyramid has base area 30 cm^2 and height 9 cm. What is its volume in cm^3? Enter just the number.
In V = (1/3)Bh, B means the perimeter around the base.
questions.explanation: B means base area, not perimeter. For a rectangular base, multiply length by width.

questions.question: A square pyramid has base side length 6 m and height 12 m. What is its volume?
questions.explanation: The base area is 6 x 6 = 36 m^2. Then V = (1/3)(36)(12) = 144 m^3.

questions.question: A prism has volume 210 cm^3. A matching pyramid has the same base and height. What is the pyramid volume in cm^3? Enter just the number.
questions.explanation: A matching pyramid has one-third the volume of the prism: 210 / 3 = 70 cm^3.

questions.question: A rectangular pyramid has a base 10 cm by 4 cm and height 6 cm. Which expression correctly finds its volume?
questions.explanation: First find the rectangular base area, 10 x 4. Then multiply by height and by one-third.

questions.question: Explain why the factor one-third appears in the pyramid volume formula.
questions.correctAnswer: The factor one-third appears because three matching pyramids with the same base area and height can fill one prism with that same base area and height.
questions.explanation: The formula V = (1/3)Bh compares the pyramid to the matching prism volume Bh.
